title: ChatGPT Reached 100 Million Users Before TikTok Did
hook: ChatGPT hit 100 million in 2 months; TikTok needed 9.
closing: That speed concentrated global AI habits around one service before rivals could respond.
question: Was that growth too fast?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users, turning an early rush into a lasting global habit.
ChatGPT needed 2 months to reach its milestone, collapsing the old app-adoption timeline.
ChatGPT serves 850 million free users, making mass adoption expensive to sustain.
